verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own integrations page says you can connect Brex and Ramp, which are card and spend platforms, and its help docs cover reconciling bank and credit-card accounts against bank statements. That implies connected bank and card accounts exist, but nothing documents a general bank feed or automatic daily transaction import. Missing for 10: documented bank-account connection (e.g., a bank-feed aggregator or supported-bank list), explicit automatic daily or recurring transaction sync, broad credit-card connectivity beyond named partners, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day
